chapter: Pictures and memories of her father
title: Microphone photo and his sweet trumpet tone
summary: Looking at a band photo with a possible microphone, they praise his sweet tone, like Harry James, as if singing.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: I noticed on this one, he seems to be playing into a microphone. I wonder, did you know where that was taken? No, I really don't.
I don't know where it was. Was that real small one?
It was a band though, because you can see the piano. Look, the piano. Yeah, that's right.
Oh yeah, that's got the whole band.
And here's another fellow right on the side with his arm there. Yeah, somebody had a...
It looks like a microphone. It's something up here. Peter?
No, you talk about sweet trumpet. Oh, sweet.
Oh man, it's a great trumpet.
Didn't he blow a trumpet? Oh, just like Harry James. The other people have told us here, wonderful tone. I mean, that wonderful tone, man.
Yeah, when he would blow an instrument, it actually looked like the words were coming out.
Looked like he was singing to you.
